label: R-I043-3

tests/test_scheduler.py.reason: adds two run_result_polling tests. The selected cap test patches bts.scheduler._now_et and calls run_result_polling(game_pk, date, picks_dir), both present at the parent (a142c14), and sets DailyPick.slot_results, a field the parent already has. The other added test (test_run_result_polling_uses_schedule_void_when_live_feed_preview) is not selected; see notes

notes: Symptom: at the parent (a142c14), run_result_polling's cap branch (patched _now_et 05:01 ET >= cap_hour_et 5, < 10) rewrites the loaded pick to result 'unresolved' and returns 'unresolved', even though the pick is already resolved 'hit'. So `assert status == "final"` fails (line 690 at 68e4cdb; the text also occurs at 576, 618, 639 and 666). _now_et is patched, so the node is deterministic, and the cap branch returns before any feed call. Static checks: bts.scheduler._now_et (line 248), run_result_polling (line 670) and the slot_results field exist at the parent; the _daily_pick helper is the module's own. This covers only the cap-overwrite half of mechanism 3. Not selected: test_run_result_polling_uses_schedule_void_when_live_feed_preview, the schedule-void overlay and the main part of mechanism 3. At the parent its game 100 stays 'preview', so the loop calls _check_hits_midgame, which uses the unpatched retry_urlopen against the live MLB feed, then _poll_interval_sleep(None, 900), and repeats until real time reaches 05:00 ET, so the red run would hang. At F it reads the real _now_et before anything else, so between 05:00 and 10:00 ET it would take the cap branch and fail at F as well. Replaying the overlay would need an adapter in that test (patch bts.scheduler._now_et and bts.scheduler._poll_interval_sleep).
